name: Notice board
description: A staff room, school or shop-floor notice board: announcement cards with colour-coded categories (Urgent, Safety, Event, HR, Info), pinned notices held at the top, and start and end dates so notices appear and expire on their own. A featured notice with the rest beside it, or one notice at a time. Type notices in, or run it from a Google Sheet or Manual table.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: subtitle
params.label: Subtitle
params.help: One line under the title, such as the site or department. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: Optional. Shown beside the title. Without one, a small board icon in the accent colour is shown.

options.label: Featured notice + the others beside it
One notice at a time, full screen

params.name: notices
params.label: Notices
params.help: One per line: Title | Text | Category | Start | End | Pinned | From. Dates: 2026-10-14, 2026-10-14 17:00, or +N days from today. Used when no data source is connected.

Benefits enrolment closes on the 30th | Check your choices in the staff portal. Drop-in help with Priya Natarajan, Tuesdays 15:00, room 2.14. | HR | | | | People team
Hi-vis on the loading dock | Forklift traffic is up this week. Vests are on the hooks by door D3. | Safety | | | | Marcus Lee
Laptop updates tonight | Leave laptops plugged in and switched on. Updates install between 22:00 and 02:00. | IT | | +1 | | IT service desk

params.name: source
params.label: Notices data source (optional)
params.help: A Google Sheet, CSV or Manual table with a row per notice. When it has the Title column it replaces the notices typed above.

params.name: start_col
params.label: Start column
params.help: Optional. A notice with a start date stays hidden until then.

params.name: end_col
params.label: End column
params.help: Optional. A notice disappears after its end date (a date alone means the end of that day).

params.name: pinned_col
params.label: Pinned column
params.help: Yes, true, 1, x or pinned keeps the notice at the top (and featured).

params.name: from_col
params.label: From column
params.help: Optional. Who posted the notice, shown small at the foot of the card.

params.name: date_order
params.label: Dates written with slashes are

options.label: Guess from the language (US: month first)

params.help: Only matters for dates like 03/04/2026. 2026-10-14 is always understood.

params.name: category_colors
params.label: Category colours
params.help: Optional overrides, one per line: Category = #RRGGBB. Urgent, Safety, Event, HR, IT, Info and others have colours already.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: Title rule, page dots and the board icon.

params.name: seconds
params.label: Seconds per page or notice
params.help: How long each page of notices (or each notice, one at a time) stays up.

params.name: until_label
params.label: Text before an end date
params.help: Leave empty for “Until …” in the screen’s language.

params.name: today_label
params.label: Text for a notice ending today
params.help: Leave empty for “Ends today” in the screen’s language.

params.name: pinned_label
params.label: Pinned badge text
params.help: Leave empty for “Pinned” in the screen’s language.

params.name: empty_label
params.label: Text when there are no notices
params.help: Leave empty for “No notices right now” in the screen’s language.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone
params.help: For the clock and for notice start and end times. Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: For the board's own words and the dates, for example en-GB or fr-FR. Leave empty for the screen's language.
